name: Power of Life
author: DrimpGD
description: Fall below the gameplay between the saw and standalone spike right before the gravity portal at 40%. At 42%, you can fall to the floor. Fly back into the gameplay at 65% before the gravity portal and stay slightly under the ceiling until 68% where you can hold to the ceiling. Drop back into the level at 74% and touch the ship portal at 75%. Continue playing normally from there.
